newsitem.title: JAPAN: Amway shares sink on weak yen worries.
newsitem.headline: Amway shares sink on weak yen worries.

text.p: Amway Japan Ltd shares sank in Thursday morning trade, undermined by worries over the effect of the weakening yen on the company's earnings, brokers said.
As of 0123 GMT the shares stood at 3,700 yen in over-the-counter trade, down from 4,030 yen on Wednesday.
Amway Japan is the distribution vehicle in Japan for Amway Corp of the United States. It specialises in door-to-door marketing of detergents, cosmetics and kitchenware, most of which are imported.
A weaker yen raises the cost of the products and could shrink sales.
